provenance: Round 1 inspected repository harness files, artifact inventory, GPU resource limits, and available helper commands before deciding whether task-E1/task-E2 could execute safely.

bounded_troubleshooting.hypothesis: A BERT-base full pretraining-step harness may exist locally and can be run from the smallest allowed batch under the 28 GiB per-GPU ceiling.
bounded_troubleshooting.result: No BERT full-step training harness exists in this repository. The only BERT harness found is docs/bert-inference.py, which runs a single BertLayer forward+backward slice. The available GPUs are RTX 5090 devices with 32607 MiB total memory, so the plan's <=28 GiB per-GPU execution ceiling is compatible with the existing slice but does not provide a missing full-step harness.
bounded_troubleshooting.next_action: Implement or provide a BERT full-step trace harness, then run batch size 1 under NVBit and replay it through the instrumented simulator.

bounded_troubleshooting.hypothesis: A Llama 3.1 8B decoder-layer slice harness may exist locally and can be run as extension evidence after the measured BERT slice path.
bounded_troubleshooting.result: No Llama decoder-layer harness exists in this repository. Existing Llama references are modeled/planning rows only. The local GPUs have 32607 MiB total memory, below the 48 GiB infrastructure requirement recorded for Llama full-step work and too close to the 28 GiB per-GPU plan ceiling to synthesize an 8B slice trace without a validated harness.
bounded_troubleshooting.next_action: Provide or implement a bounded Llama decoder-layer harness with explicit memory controls, then run trace export and simulator replay as task-E2.
